title: Omada Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA), the virtual between-visit healthcare provider, reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
November 5, 2026


# Omada Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


- *Quarterly Revenue of $91 Million and All-Time High Total Members of 1.1 million*


- *Revenue Grew 34% and Total Members Increased 36% Year over Year*
- *Raises Full-Year 2026 Financial Outlook*


SAN FRANCISCO - November 5, 2026 -


[Omada Health](https://www.omadahealth.com/) , Inc. (Nasdaq: OMDA), the virtual between-visit healthcare provider, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Financial Highlights**


- **Revenue** of $91 million, compared with total revenue of $68 million in Q3 2025


- **Gross margin** of 76% in the third quarter, up from 66% in Q3 2025


- **Non-GAAP gross margin** of 78% in the third quarter, up from 68% in Q3 2025


- **Net income** of $7 million in the third quarter, compared with a net loss of $3 million in Q3 2025


- **Adjusted EBITDA** of $12 million in the third quarter, compared with Adjusted EBITDA of $2 million in Q3 2025


- **Trailing 12-month revenue per Total Member** grew approximately 5% year over year to $294


- **Cash and cash equivalents** of $243 million


*Please see the non-GAAP Financial Measures section below and reconciliations of GAAP to non-GAAP measures at the end of this press release.*


**Operational Highlights**


- Total Members reached 1.1 million, increasing 36% year over year, reflecting continued demand across Omada Health’s integrated cardiometabolic care platform and strong enrollment momentum across diabetes and hypertension programs.


- Average member tenure grew 10% year over year to approximately 2 years and 4 months, which is roughly an additional 2.5 months in program.


“Omada Health delivered its strongest quarter yet, with revenue growing 34% year over year, Total Members increasing 36% and a GAAP gross margin of 76%,”


**said Sean Duffy, co-founder and CEO of Omada Health** . “Our diabetes and hypertension programs led that growth, and average tenure in our programs reached a record of roughly two years and four months. That gives members more time to build lasting habits and the confidence to manage their health. "


**Financial Outlook**


For the year ending December 31, 2026, Omada Health expects:


- Revenue in the range of $344 million to $346 million, up from prior guidance of $334 million to $340 million, with the midpoint representing approximately 33% growth compared with 2025.


- Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $32 million to $34 million, up from prior guidance of $21 million to $27 million, with the midpoint representing an improvement of approximately $27 million, or roughly five and a half times, compared with 2025.


We have not provided an outlook for net income (loss) (GAAP) or a reconciliation of expected Adjusted EBITDA to net income (loss) (GAAP) because net income (loss) (GAAP) on a forward-looking basis is not available without unreasonable effort due to the potential variability and complexity of the items that are excluded from Adjusted EBITDA, such as loss on debt extinguishment; provision for income taxes; depreciation and amortization; share-based compensation; change in fair value of warrant liabilities; amortization of intangible assets; and loss on disposal of property and equipment.
